recipe: Resident image pool on a 300 W workstation card: flux2-klein-4b, 61 images/min peak, about 50 sustained
note: Every entry is a transcription made by the studio. The basis field is the studio's original wording; read it with the label in the recipe: an entry without a published raw file is REPORTED, whatever its basis says.

receipts.value: 0.98 s per image; 61.2 images/min steady (62.0 counted in the window)
receipts.caveat: 30 to 36 second windows from a cool start (GPU at or below 74 C), one prompt, fixed seeds, 4 steps, 1024x1024. This is a peak, not a sustained rate: the card reaches 88 C within about 45 to 60 s at the 300 W limit.

receipts.claim: More workers or batching on top of one resident worker
receipts.value: flat: 59 to 62 images/min for 1, 2, 3, 4 workers; batch 2 / 4 / 8 gives 59.6 / 56.7 / 57.1
receipts.caveat: Same short windows as I-02. One worker already uses 93 to 100% of the card at the power limit; extra workers add latency and memory, not throughput.

receipts.claim: One resident worker with the thermal governor on (hold 88 C, resume 84 C, stop 91 C)
receipts.value: 54.7 images/min over 180 s, duty about 91%, 14 pauses
receipts.caveat: Equilibrium at 87 to 88 C. One window, one prompt.

receipts.claim: Live bursts through the production image API, resident pool, 2 slots for this model
receipts.value: 737 images in 883.5 s (50.1/min) and 807 images in 955.7 s (50.7/min); highest 900 s window 761 images; 0 failures
receipts.caveat: Counts are jobs whose final state landed in the window, per-minute counts range 40 to 52. 8 jobs in burst 1 were cancelled on purpose. Another card was serving a different workload at its 300 W limit at the same time; the effect of one card on the other was not measured. Quality was spot-checked, not scored.

receipts.claim: Series of short governed windows through the same harness
receipts.value: 94 windows, median 51.2 images/min (range 48.5 to 54.2); GPU peak 89 C; 1,645 governor pauses in total
receipts.caveat: Windows of about four minutes, interleaved with other jobs over about 14 hours of wall time (48 hand-overs to other jobs). Every window is labelled "complete but cooling-governed", so these are paced numbers, not a stress-test pass. Images were not kept. This is not a long soak.

receipts.claim: Per-image latency in the governed windows
receipts.value: median of per-window p50 0.97 s; median of per-window p95 2.88 s
receipts.caveat: The p95 is dominated by pauses at the 88 C hold.

receipts.claim: Power and clocks in the governed windows
receipts.value: median average board power 263.6 W, maximum 308.3 W; median average SM clock 1,761 MHz
receipts.caveat: Power limit left at the stock 300 W and clocks stock. The sole throttle-reason values seen were 0x0 and 0x4 (software power cap); no thermal-slowdown bit appeared in these windows.

receipts.value: about 20.3 GiB per flux2-klein-4b worker, about 26 GiB for the 50-step model; card baseline 1.7 GiB; 4 workers = 82.8 GiB; 6 workers ran out of memory at load
receipts.caveat: 5 workers is arithmetic (about 103 GiB), not a run.

receipts.claim: Mixed pool: 2 workers of the 4-step model plus 1 of the 50-step model
receipts.value: 4-step jobs kept a 3.1 s latency while a 36 s image rendered beside them
receipts.caveat: A 100 s window. The recorded pause duration of this run is wrong (computed after the long job finished); throughput and latencies are valid.

receipts.value: +6 to +9% in three A/B pairs; not adopted
receipts.caveat: Three pairs, no more; inside what a thermal state change could explain.

receipts.claim: Cold start of the pool after idle
receipts.value: about 14 s for the initial image; pool unloads after 120 s idle
receipts.caveat: Warm page cache. A cold-disk load was not measured.
Licence as declared on the model card, read 2026-11-06. The licence text itself and trademark terms were not reviewed by a lawyer.

receipts.value: image quality scores; runs longer than about 16 minutes of continuous burst; effect on the other card; torch.compile, fp8 or NVFP4 transformer; cold disk
receipts.caveat: Listed so nobody reads their absence as a pass.
